findings.rationale: Deleting CustomResourceDefinition widgets.acme.io cascades to every custom resource of that kind, which is among the largest blast radii in Kubernetes and is not undone by re-applying the manifest.
Deleting Namespace legacy cascades to every object inside it, which is among the largest blast radii in Kubernetes and is not undone by re-applying the manifest.
